description: Trigger + functional eval set for the agy-image skill. Direct/indirect prompts should route here; negatives (editing, analysis, other generators) should not. Failure-mode cases come from real runs on agy 1.2.16-1.4.x and are mirrored by the deterministic tests in scripts/test_agy_image.py.

evals.prompt: 用 agy 生一張 9:16 的夜景人像，皮膚白皙、俏皮表情
evals.expected_output: Routes to agy-image; resolves 9:16 to explicit pixels and generates a PNG at that exact size.

evals.prompt: Generate an image with the agy CLI, 4:5, of a neon-lit city street at night
evals.expected_output: Routes to agy-image; translates 4:5 to explicit width/height and produces a verified PNG.
expectations: uses explicit width/height not aspect-ratio shorthand
attaches the image inline with its actual size

evals.prompt: 用 antigravity cli 跑一張圖，要 1024x1536 直式，不要方圖
evals.expected_output: Routes to agy-image; passes width=1024 height=1536 and forbids the 1024x1024 square fallback.
expectations: enables the crop fallback if the size drifts

evals.prompt: 幫我用 antigravity 出一張角色一致的寫真，參考我存的幾張臉部圖
evals.expected_output: Routes to agy-image; passes the reference images via --ref/--refs-dir for identity lock.
expectations: passes the reference images for identity
keeps the prompt about scene not facial features

evals.prompt: agy 又吐了一張 1024x1024 方圖，但我要 4:5，幫我把尺寸修好
evals.expected_output: Routes to agy-image; re-runs or applies --crop to enforce the exact 4:5 pixel size.
expectations: uses --crop to enforce the exact size

evals.prompt: 用 Midjourney 生一張貓咪太空人漂浮在太空的圖
evals.expected_output: Does not route to agy-image; this names a different, non-agy image generator.
expectations: defers to the explicitly requested generator

evals.prompt: Edit this existing photo to remove the background and brighten the subject
evals.expected_output: Does not route to agy-image; this is editing an existing image, not agy generation.

evals.prompt: 用 agy 幫我分析這張圖片裡面有哪些物件、人物和文字內容
evals.expected_output: Does not route to agy-image; agy is named but the task is image analysis, not generation.
expectations: treats this as image analysis not generation

evals.prompt: 用 agy 生一張 16:9 的影片背景，上次它說沒產出檔案，但圖其實在 brain 資料夾裡
evals.expected_output: Routes to agy-image; runs the wrapper, which recovers the image from the agy brain folder into --out and reports source=brain with the verified size.
expectations: reports the verified actual size and that the image came from the brain folder
does not tell the user generation failed when the JSON status is completed

evals.prompt: antigravity 一直生圖失敗，log 說 image quota exhausted，幫我再跑十張
evals.expected_output: Routes to agy-image; treats quota_exhausted as a stop condition, reports the reset time, and asks before a batch of more than three images instead of retrying in a loop.
expectations: stops on error_kind quota_exhausted instead of retrying
asks before running a batch larger than three images

evals.prompt: Use agy to make a 4:5 photo of my character from ref.png, last time it said read_file permission denied
evals.expected_output: Routes to agy-image; runs with --ref, and on error_kind permission_denied asks the user before adding an allow-rule or passing --allow-agy-permissions, offering a retry without --ref.
expectations: does not pass --allow-agy-permissions without the user's approval
explains the permission_denied next step from the failure table

evals.prompt: 用 agy 重畫一張 ~/agy_images/onsen.png，同一個檔名覆蓋掉舊的
evals.expected_output: Routes to agy-image; because the file exists, confirms the overwrite (the user asked for it here) and runs with --overwrite, never reporting the old file as the new result.
expectations: passes --overwrite only because the user asked to replace the file
reports the size of the newly generated file
